subject.title: feat(ui): redesign cron page as sidebar-first Automations master-detail

question: Should Automations be pinned only for new or defaultless setups while every valid persisted sidebar selection remains unchanged?
rationale: The settings loader cannot distinguish an automatically persisted old default from a deliberately minimal user selection, so changing existing overview-only selections would require an intentional preference-overwrite policy.

options.title: Preserve existing pins
options.body: Apply the new Automations pin only to new or defaultless setups and leave every valid persisted selection unchanged.

options.title: Migrate overview-only pins
options.body: Treat persisted ["overview"] as the former default and append Automations, accepting that some deliberate user preferences will be overwritten.

options.title: Drop the default-pin change
options.body: Ship the page redesign without changing the default sidebar set until a safer upgrade rule exists.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing pins
recommendation.body: Apply the new Automations pin only to new or defaultless setups and leave every valid persisted selection unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current customizable sidebar contract and recent cron UX, making him the strongest history-backed owner for this product decision.
